method: Original Flask routes/templates, SQLite memory, sockets blocked, 4 fixtures x 6 URLs x 2 fresh-session requests; SQL statements and ORM object loads, not latency.
limitations: No PostgreSQL query plans, row-scan counts, browser rendering or production timings.
Only past events in current season, one variant per article, no orders/claims/ratings.
Loaded ORM objects count load events, not necessarily unique database identities across a request.
